provider: Arab Fund for Arts and Culture (AFAC)
whoCanApply: Tunisian ELIGIBLE. Quote: 'AFAC welcomes proposals from individuals from Arab countries (22 member states of the Arab League), regardless of their place of residence, citizenship, or ethnic and national identification.' Tunisia is an Arab League member state.
subjectScope: Music. Funds 'music production, performances, collaborations, album recordings, music-related podcasts, and festivals.' PROJECT funding, NOT tuition. Does NOT cover a master's degree as such.
coverage: Up to USD 25,000 individuals/teams; up to USD 35,000 collectives/institutions. Covers materials, equipment rental, artistic and technical fees, artist fees (max 30% of grant). Tuition eligibility UNVERIFIED - guidelines do not explicitly address it and emphasis is on production not personal education.
deadline: PRIOR/CURRENT CYCLE: open call 15 April 2026, deadline 19 June 2026 17:00 GMT+3, results 16 Nov 2026. Expected 2027 cycle: approx April-June 2027 (same annual pattern).
requiresWorkExperience: No formal bar, but track record/portfolio effectively required
languageRequirement: Arabic or English (also French accepted - UNVERIFIED)
notes: STRATEGIC USE: not a tuition scholarship. Best used to fund a production project (EP/album/research) alongside or before the master's, strengthening his portfolio. Do not count on it for fees. FLAG: 19 June 2026 deadline falls BEFORE September 2026.

whoCanApply: Tunisian ELIGIBLE by nationality. Quote: 'must be by artists or arts practitioners from or living in the Arab world, and/or engaged with the Arab world.' Institutions not eligible.
subjectScope: Contemporary arts, all disciplines incl. music/sound. BUT DEGREE STUDY EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED. Quote: 'applications to attend degree-based study programs (such as MAs or PhDs) are out of the grant program's scope and will not be considered.'
coverage: Average USD 5,000 per grant. Research, events, new work, publishing, travel, residencies, workshops.
duration: Outcome must be achievable within 12 months of the deadline
numberOfAwards: Approximately fifteen grants per calendar year
deadline: 1 October (annual). PRIOR CYCLE: 1 Oct 2026 stated. Expected 2027 cycle: 1 October 2027.
howToApply: Online application in English or Arabic only
requiresWorkExperience: No stated bar; artistic track record required
competitiveness: Very high - ~15 grants/year for the whole Arab world
notes: RULED OUT for funding the master's itself - degree study is explicitly out of scope. Only usable for a separate practice project. Recorded so it is not re-investigated.

whoCanApply: Tunisian ELIGIBLE - Tunisia is listed in the Fund's 'South Zone' (with Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Egypt, Mauritania, Jordan, Syria, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, Turkey, Arabian Gulf). Individuals only (artists, managers, producers, researchers, curators), not organisations. Priority to 'candidates with little access to mobility and/or who are poorly inserted into international cultural circuits'.
ageLimit: No age restriction stated - he clears it
subjectScope: All arts and culture incl. music/sound. TRAVEL only - it funds mobility, not tuition or a degree. Eligible activities on sister scheme include 'participation in artistic and professional training/education (internships, masterclasses, exchanges, study trips)'.
coverage: Lump sum. Reported ranges EUR 500-700 (general fund) and EUR 500-1,500 (Gil Mendo scheme). Covers tickets, visas, accommodation partially. Paid AFTER the trip on presentation of receipts, written report and visuals.
deadline: UNVERIFIED - the Fund runs rolling and periodic calls (TAE'THIR, ALFinMOTION, NACP North Africa Cultural Program, J-MED, Med Youth Meeting). Could not confirm a 2027 window from the official site; the homepage does not publish a consolidated calendar.
howToApply: Via cimettafund.org 'Grants & Opportunities' section; contact cimetta@cimettafund.org
notes: NOT a scholarship - too small to matter for fees. Genuinely useful for ONE thing: funding a trip to Europe for an audition, entrance exam or open day at a conservatoire (several production masters require an on-site practical exam). Also check its North Africa Cultural Program (NACP) which specifically targets his region. Amounts and deadlines UNVERIFIED from official pages.

provider: Berklee College of Music - Valencia campus
whoCanApply: All master's degree applicants - NO nationality restriction found, so a Tunisian is eligible. Quote: 'Applicants receive a scholarship decision after acceptance into a master's degree program.'
subjectScope: YES - directly covers MM in Music Production, Technology, and Innovation (MPTI), the flagship production master's.
coverage: Merit- AND need-based tuition discount; amount varies by merit. 'Scholarship funds are allocated based on artistic, academic, and professional accomplishments as well as the financial resources of the candidates.' Exact amounts not published - UNVERIFIED.
duration: 1 year (the MM is a one-year degree)
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE: 15 November (early) and 1 February (regular). Expected 2027 entry: 15 Nov 2026 early / 1 Feb 2027 regular. FLAG: the early round 15 Nov 2026 is only just after Sept 2026 - preparation must start well before.
howToApply: Automatic consideration - submit the scholarship application alongside the admission application
requiresAdmissionFirst: YES - decision issued only after acceptance to the programme. This drives the timeline: admission application first, in autumn 2026.
languageRequirement: English - IELTS/TOEFL required (he has NOT taken IELTS yet - book it)
competitiveness: High; Berklee tuition is very high so even a large percentage award leaves a big gap
notes: Berklee Valencia MPTI is the single most on-target production master's with a real institutional scholarship budget. But no award covers 100% and living costs in Valencia are not covered. Treat as a stretch option requiring co-funding.

provider: Berklee College of Music - Valencia campus

notes: BEST-FIT Berklee award for him. Requires an extra deliverable (video/essay) so budget time. Can stack with the General Scholarship - UNVERIFIED whether they combine.
